subject: Life Skills
title: Rebuilding Trust Takes Time
description: A quick, practical guide to Rebuilding Trust Takes Time.

hook.text: Trust takes years to build and seconds to break. But research shows it can be rebuilt with consistent action.

buildup.text: After a betrayal, the injured person needs repeated proof that behavior has genuinely changed.

discovery.text: Trust rebuilds through small, consistent actions over time. Grand gestures feel hollow without daily follow-through.

twist.text: Demanding trust too quickly re-injures the person. Patience with their timeline shows genuine remorse.

climax.text: Be transparent, follow through on every promise, and accept accountability without defensiveness.

punchline.text: Trust rebuilds in drops, not floods. Be patient.

quiz.question: What is the most effective way to rebuild broken trust?
options: Avoiding the topic until it fades away
